description: §22.12 (S460 N5) positive — a control inside an emitted `<template>` is admitted at an insertion point inside a page form: inert template content joins no form.
rationale: §22.12 *Insertion inside a page form*: the rule does not apply to an HTML `<template>`'s content; every other rule does. (S460 differential review N5, PA-dispatched)
